Nina (Marketing): Heads-up: Skyline Labs case study + webinar promo needs final approvals. Customer quote for hero banner + a 45s testimonial clip. Can we lock content and routing by tomorrow morning?
Omar (Growth): Webinar is scheduled 2026-05-05 16:00 UTC. We want the promo live 2026-04-28. Need to wire lead routing to a nurture in HubSpot and a dedicated SFDC campaign.
Priya (CS): I have the quote but the customer keeps a compliance clause that references contract IDs. Legal will need to sign off or we can remove that bit. I'll ask them to ok a publication-friendly variant.
Hana (Legal): Send the redline I recommended. We can't publish contract IDs or any revenue numbers without explicit opt-in. Suggest replacing with a high-level percent or anonymized phrasing.
Nina (Marketing): OK—requesting a sanitized quote from customer: keep the impact stat but remove contract references. Also we need permission to use their logo. Priya please send a short checkbox consent for logo + quote.
Priya (CS): Done. Sent consent via DocuSign with checkbox: logo use + quote + webinar participation. ETA 6 hours.
Omar (Growth): Ad ask: produce 45s long-form for organic, 15s + 6s cuts for paid. Add UTM structure: utm_source=web, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=skyline_case_apac. Funnel mapping: webinar registrants -> SFDC campaign -> HubSpot workflow (leadscore + nurture 7 days).
PublishBot: Draft campaign created: "Skyline_Case_APAC_2026". HubSpot workflow placeholder: "Skyline_Case_Nurture_7d". Use /publish finalize to lock.
Nina (Marketing): Creative brief: open 4s logo lockup, 30s customer quote focus, 6s CTA card. Subtitles required EN and JA (burned). Lower third: "Skyline Labs — CTO, Arjun Patel". Also need a short blog post (600 words) linking to benchmark appendix.
Omar (Growth): Can we include a brief benchmark snippet comparing RDW-dedicated vs managed infra? Need approval from research team on numbers.
Nina (Marketing): Yes, research signoff required. I've pinged Mei in research—asking for verification of comparative latency and cost delta.
Priya (CS): Customer signed the DocuSign consent; they explicitly okayed logo and quote but asked to avoid mentioning exact latency p99 figure. They gave greenlight for percentage improvements only.
Hana (Legal): Approved. Replace exact p99 with "~30% improvement in 99th percentile latency". All good. :thumbsup:
Nina (Marketing): Great. Publish schedule: promo live 2026-04-28T09:00:00Z, blog post scheduled same day 09:15Z, webinar registration page live now. Embargo lift for case study pdf 2026-05-05 15:00Z (one hour before webinar).
Omar (Growth): I'll allocate paid budget for 4/281/05. Owner: growth@redwood.com. Will attach creative specs and audience targets once exports are ready.
Nina (Marketing): PublishBot 1: please run pre-publish checklist when creative assets uploaded. Checklist should include: render master, exports (45s/15s/6s), burned subtitles EN/JA, CDN upload, SFDC campaign finalize, HubSpot nurture activation, blog scheduling, tweet/linkedin copy + visuals, UTM tagging, embed webinar registration.
PublishBot: Pre-publish checklist created. Items: render_master_skyline_v1.mov, skyline_45s.mp4, skyline_15s.mp4, skyline_6s.mp4, en.srt, ja.srt, s3://redwood-marketing/skyline/, SFDC: Skyline_Case_APAC_2026, HubSpot: Skyline_Case_Nurture_7d, blog: /content/case-studies/skyline, social_posts_ready.
Nina (Marketing): Scheduling a final review 2026-04-28 08:00Z. Please add to calendars. Priya, monitor customer Slack during publish. Hana, be available for last-minute legal checks.
Priya (CS): Added event. I'll be online during publish.
Hana (Legal): Available for the window.
Omar (Growth): Added to calendar. Confirming lead routing: HubSpot form submissions will create SFDC leads with tag "case_skyline" and trigger the nurture.
Nina (Marketing): Awesome. Closing thread for now 1: post back when assets are uploaded and checklist passes. :sparkles:
